svg.title: ProofRunKit architecture overview
svg.desc: Lua and JavaScript test scripts are run by the single compiled ProofRunKit executable. The prk CLI loads each script into a sandboxed Lua 5.4 or QuickJS-ng engine, tests register through the prk API into the C17 test plan and runner, which uses Assembly hot paths with a C fallback. The prk API shells out to real toolchains (MSVC, gcc, clang, MASM, GAS, NASM) through the process-spawn layer and gets results back. Reporters write console, JSON and JUnit XML and set the exit code. CMake presets build the executable, WiX packages a Windows x64 MSI, GitHub Releases publish it with a SHA-256 file, and prk -update downloads, verifies and installs it.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: One executable, compiled once. Tests are scripts loaded at run time; real compilers and assemblers are called as separate processes.
